verdict.rationale: Warp explicitly published its client source code on GitHub under the AGPL v3 open-source license, documented in both its privacy docs and a dedicated blog post announcing the move to open source. missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation of the full scope of open-sourced code (e.g., whether cloud/server-side agent components are also included) and any hands-on community audit of the repository beyond the vendor's own announcement.
